_comment: Fill in the fields below, then save as ~/.copilot/atlassian-config.json (Windows: %USERPROFILE%\.copilot\atlassian-config.json). Shared with the original 'atlassian' skill.

_help.email: Your Atlassian account email address (e.g. you@yourcompany.com)
_help.site: Your Atlassian site domain, no https:// prefix (e.g. your-org.atlassian.net)
_help.cloudId: Optional. Leave as '' and skill will auto-fetch on first run
_help.token: Optional. Leave as '' and skill will auto-generate from email + api_token
_help.mirror_project_key: Your team's Jira project key. Tickets you create in other projects are mirrored here.
_help.mirror_enabled: Set to false to turn mirroring off without uninstalling
_help.mirror_status_fallback: Mirror status to use when the original's status name doesn't exist in the mirror project, by status category
_help.atlassian_gad_source_raw_base: Raw GitHub base URL used by '/atlassian-gad update'
